standard_prerequisites.name: Gluing lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Builds the divided power structure on J from structures on IA<x> and A<x>_+ after checking the intersection condition.

standard_prerequisites.name: Extension along flat maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends gamma to IA<x> since A -> A<x> is flat.

standard_prerequisites.name: Torsionfree criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the divided power structure on A<x>_+ when A is torsionfree.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Handles the general (non-torsionfree) case via the R/a presentation of A.

core_obligations: Reduce to one variable; note J = IA<x> + A<x>_+ and the intersection equals the product.
Build the structure on IA<x> by flatness (gamma-extends) and on A<x>_+ by silly (4) if torsionfree, else by the R/a presentation and kernel criterion (2)(c); glue by two-ideals.
Universal property: map monomials x_1^{[n_1]} ... x_t^{[n_t]} to epsilon_{n_1}(k_1) ... epsilon_{n_t}(k_t); check it is an A-algebra homomorphism; invert by restriction.
proof_roadmap: Assemble the glued structure from the two ideal pieces and verify the universal property by the monomial-basis map.
difficulty_reason: The gluing assembly routes four in-chapter lemmas; the universal-property direction needs the monomial bookkeeping got exactly right.
